unicode-space: " ok \u{9}": trim then lower-case
unicode-space: "\u{a0}OK\u{3000}": JS trim strips NBSP and U+3000
unicode-space: "\u{feff}OK": JS trim strips U+FEFF; Rust str::trim does not
unicode-space: "\u{85}OK": JS trim keeps U+0085; Rust str::trim strips it
unicode-space: "OK\u{200b}": U+200B is not whitespace to either
case-mapping: "O\u{212a}": U+212A KELVIN SIGN lower-cases to k, so this is ok
other: "TwoFactorRequired": twofactor without a space
other: "Mobile Authenticator": mobile
other: "Check your EMAIL": email
other: "Login Denied": login denied
other: "Logon Denied, two factor by email": two factor is checked before logon denied

args: Logon Denied, two factor by email

origin.ref: other: "Logon denied: password": logon denied is checked before password
other: "Password expired": password is checked before expired
other: "Expired rate limit": expired is checked before rate limit
other: "Throttled": throttle
unicode-space: "Rate  Limit": two spaces are not rate limit
unicode-space: "Rate\u{a0}Limit": an NBSP is not the space in rate limit
case-mapping: "EMA\u{130}L": İ lower-cases to i plus U+0307, so EMAİL is not email
case-mapping: "PASSWORD \u{130}nvalid": PASSWORD still lower-cases to password
case-mapping: "PA\u{17f}\u{17f}WORD": ſ (long s) stays ſ under toLowerCase, so this is not password
case-mapping: "\u{ff30}\u{ff21}\u{ff33}\u{ff33}\u{ff37}\u{ff2f}\u{ff32}\u{ff24}": fullwidth letters lower-case to fullwidth, not ASCII
lone-surrogate: "\u{d800} Password": a lone surrogate passes through trim and toLowerCase
unicode-space: " \u{9}\u{2028} ": only whitespace is empty, so none
